ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

EyebrowText.helper: Optional. A short label shown above the main heading.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Main section heading. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Supporting text shown below the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render in the view.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Use this area for a short, centered introduction to the section.

Cta1Text.helper: Optional. Button text for the primary call to action.

Cta1Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Cta1Url.helper: Optional. Full web addresses or relative page path for button 1.
